title: 我走丢了
subtitle: 别怕，我知道该怎么做
character: wearing a green hoodie, beige trousers and white sneakers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, pen and ink line drawing with soft watercolor washes, warm friendly colors, clean simple shapes, signs and shelves without any writing
facts: 走丢了先停下来，爸爸妈妈会回来找
穿制服的工作人员、警察，或带小朋友的阿姨
背熟爸爸妈妈的电话号码
不跟不认识的人离开这里

pages.zh:
周末，妈妈带我去超市。
超市好大好大，
货架比我还要高。
妈妈说：「牵好我的手哦。」
pages.scene: The little boy holds his mother's hand as they walk into a big bright supermarket with tall shelves, the mother is a grown adult woman with short hair in a blue coat pushing a shopping cart.

pages.zh:
我看到了好多好多玩具，
一下子松开妈妈的手，
跑了过去。
pages.scene: The little boy runs happily down a supermarket aisle toward shelves full of colorful toys, his arms swinging.

pages.zh:
我回头一看——
妈妈不见了！
到处都是不认识的人，
我的心咚咚咚地跳。
pages.scene: The little boy stands alone in a supermarket aisle looking around with a worried face, tall shelves on both sides, blurry shoppers far away in the background.

pages.zh:
我想起妈妈说过：
走丢了，先站在原地，
不要乱跑。
妈妈一定会回来找我。
pages.scene: The little boy stands still at the end of a supermarket shelf, taking a deep breath with his hands at his sides, a calm and brave face.

pages.zh:
可以找谁帮忙呢？
找穿着制服的「工作人员」，
或者带着小朋友的阿姨。
pages.scene: A friendly supermarket staff member in a green uniform apron with a name badge standing at a checkout counter, and nearby a mother holding her small daughter's hand.

pages.zh:
我走到收银台，
对阿姨说：
「阿姨，我找不到妈妈了。」
pages.scene: The little boy stands in front of a checkout counter talking to a kind cashier woman in a green uniform apron, who leans down toward him to listen.

pages.zh:
阿姨问我叫什么名字。
我大声说出了自己的名字，
还背出了妈妈的电话号码。
pages.scene: At the checkout counter the kind cashier holds a telephone to her ear while the little boy stands beside her speaking clearly and pointing to himself.

pages.zh:
超市里的广播响了：
「请穿绿色卫衣的小朋友的妈妈，
到收银台来。」
pages.scene: A loudspeaker on the ceiling of a big supermarket with soft sound waves drawn coming out of it, shoppers below looking up and listening.

pages.zh:
妈妈跑了过来，
一把抱住了我。
「宝贝，你做得真好！」
pages.scene: The mother in her blue coat kneels down by the checkout and hugs the little boy tightly, both relieved and happy, the kind cashier smiling behind them.

pages.zh:
回家的路上，我牵紧妈妈的手。
我记住了三件事：
站着不动，
找工作人员，
说出电话号码。
pages.scene: The little boy and his mother walk home hand in hand along a tree-lined street at sunset, the mother carrying a shopping bag, both smiling.
